rows.item: Repository was a 6-byte stub with no requirements, sources, license, CI or verification policy.
COORDINATION.md did not exist at session start.
GitHub Pages uses legacy Jekyll from main /; .nojekyll added to protect static assets.
Official market odds / closing lines unavailable. All market price, vig, CLV and ROI cells blank.
2026-27 season only 4-7 games per team; all strategy-level samples under-powered.
Only 62 of 92 games in the snapshot window transcribed from official games pages.
NBA.com Game Leaders links ending in /null (official-site link defect).
official.nba.com/rulebook returned only a heading; rule text unavailable.
cdn.nba.com static JSON endpoints returned HTTP 500; manual line-by-line transcription used.
Third-party pages excluded; one showed implausible 2026-27 figures (38.0 PPG, 100% 3P%).
Player table reports 442 rows; 8 transcribed. No game-level player logs, so prop fair lines are blank.
Home/away designation not exposed; per-game home-court adjustment blank.
Platform pins the session to one branch; per-session branches/worktrees not possible.
M1 prior-season model: 0.780 train accuracy but 0.476 holdout accuracy and negative holdout Brier skill. Not skill-based.
Cooper Flagg player row was truncated by the retrieval tool; five fields blank + UNVERIFIED.
No strategy cleared all validation gates; Division B leaderboard has no eligible entries and no rewards.

Home/away convention cannot be settled from official data: the second-listed team won 31/62 (0.500) in the transcribed sample vs a verified league home win rate of 48/92 (0.5217). No convention is asserted.

Parallel-session collision: concurrent sessions merged PRs #11-#14/#16 into main, publishing a canonical root dashboard overlapping this session's index.html, pages/*, README.md, COORDINATION.md, EXECUTIVE_SUMMARY.md and data/sources.json. PR #15 was CONFLICTING.

The shared root COORDINATION.md committed by earlier concurrent sessions contains an unresolved git conflict-marker block (<<<<<<< HEAD ... >>>>>>> origin/main) around the arena/42d467e4-own4 section. Left verbatim to avoid discarding another session's work; flagged for manual cleanup.
